name: example
rules:
# busride game rules. Set these to match the game you play (docs/SPEC.md, section 5),
# then run `busride analyze`.

[game]
name = "Ride the Bus"
game_version = "built-in"
captured_on = ""
description = "Red or black, higher or lower, inside or outside, then the suit."
# Stake limits; 0 = not recorded.
min_stake = 0
max_stake = 0
# What a draw that runs out of time does: unknown | lose | cash_out | random_guess
timeout = "unknown"

[deck]
# fresh_52 (new deck every round) | with_replacement (cards can repeat) | shoe
model = "fresh_52"
# Only used by "shoe".
decks = 1
# high | low | either (either = whichever value helps you)
ace = "high"

[ties]
# lose | push | win. A push ends the round and pays your current cash-out value.
higher_lower = "lose"
# The same, for a card equal to either end of the inside/outside range.
range_edge = "lose"

[payout]
# Total payout per 1 staked, stake included, if you cash out after surviving each stage.
return_after_stage = [1.8, 2.3, 3.2, 12.0]
